headline: The 12% Increase to the Minimum Wage That Few Question
summary: The government pledged minimum wage increases of about 12% in 2025 and at least 12% a year through the term. The National Minimum Wage Commission is set to decide in a couple of weeks.
why: Minimum wage levels affect labour costs for employers across the economy, particularly in retail, services and manufacturing. They also feed into inflation and consumer spending.
original_headline: El 12% de incremento al salario mínimo que pocos cuestionan
